description: This repository extends its own preset, default.json, read from master, so
a rule changed there reaches this repository the same way it reaches every
other. The overrides below are this repository's merge shape: rebase-merged
pull requests that GitHub's own auto-merge finishes once `check` is green,
and a `security` label on vulnerability-alert PRs, which auto-release's
security lane reads to release outside the weekly batch.

customManagers.description: Annotated version pins inside workflow files (e.g. HELMCTL_VERSION)
